facts.fact: The Lagos e-Birth registration platform, launched 13 November 2025 by UNICEF and the Lagos State Government, automatically links a newborn to a National Identification Number where at least one parent already has one, the NPC's Lagos commissioner says.

The e-CRVS platform was launched by President Tinubu on 8 November 2023, and the NPC says e-birth registration is rolling out state by state, already launched in Lagos (13 November 2025), Nasarawa, Kano, Borno and Enugu.

facts.fact: In Lagos and other launched states the e-Birth platform links each newborn registered to the NIN from birth, Governor Sanwo-Olu and the NPC commissioner said at and after the 13 November 2025 launch.
